# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and companion  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta the Fourth is known for her remarkably wide smiles and cheerful grins. She wears her hair braided in innumerable plaits, often adorned with lively blue bows.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted, cheerful, and intensely loyal handmaiden. She is extremely obedient and dedicated to her mistress, willing to carry out almost any order given to her. Unlike her sisters who preceded her, she never shows or expresses any judgment toward Miss Lavendar's silly pretendings.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)_

- Baking and cooking skills  <sub>[v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>

## History

Leonora Bowman, nicknamed Charlotta the Fourth, came to live at Echo Lodge as a handmaiden to Miss Lavendar Lewis, following in the footsteps of her three older sisters. She served her mistress with great devotion, keeping her secrets, tending the garden, and assisting around the house. When visitors like Anne Shirley and Diana Barry came to Echo Lodge, Charlotta greeted them warmly for the sake of her mistress. She assisted with sewing Miss Lavendar's organdy dress and expressed genuine concern to Anne when Miss Lavendar seemed out of spirits. Before Miss Lavendar's wedding, Charlotta threw herself enthusiastically into helping Anne and Diana prepare the stone house for the event.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the last of the Bowman sisters to serve Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Was nicknamed 'Charlotta the Fourth' by Miss Lavendar to avoid confusion with her older sisters  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
